name: MARS sell hook burns pair reserves and syncs
summary: On each transfer into the MARS/WBNB pair 0x27a792d5 (a sell), the closed-source MARS token burns MARS from the pair's own balance (Transfer pair -> 0x0) and calls pair.sync() before the sold tokens arrive. Repeated sells therefore ratchet down the recorded MARS reserve and raise the WBNB price. The attacker flash-borrowed 350 WBNB from PancakeV3, bought in 1000-MARS chunks through fresh receiver contracts, and sold back in 1000-MARS chunks, triggering 195 burn+sync cycles. The seed and PoC 'reflection' description does not match the receipt.

loss.notes: Imported $100,000 is unverified. Source-1 alone depletes the pair by 21.207690225708611838 WBNB. The campaign includes a copycat (-33.23 WBNB), the attacker's second transaction (-82.71 WBNB) and further multi-burn transactions (source-5), so the full gross depletion is unresolved.

ageReset.description: Provisional deployment basis. User sells were gated until block 37901366, and the owner configured burn parameters afterwards. Which persistent change, if any, is the latest causal reset is unresolved (source-5).

limitations: Source is unverified. The burn-on-sell mechanism is established behaviourally from receipts and traces, but its code-level trigger and parameters are not.

Age basis unresolved. A user transfer to the pair reverts with custom error 0x51ce60ad through block 37901365 and passes from 37901366, when users' BNB mint transactions ran; the first burns are at 37901367. Owner calls setBurnRate(220) (block 37898171), setOverFlowBurnAmount(1e24) (37898179), setTotalMintCount(10) (37901326; slot 0xe 2 -> 10) and unknown selector 0x7700d8cf (10e18 at 37898176, 1000e18 at 37901400) all precede the exploit. Which of these, or the mint-threshold crossing, is necessary to the burn path needs bytecode analysis.

sources.note: onchain review (seed import): victim 0x436D3629888B50127EC4947D54Bb0aB1120962A0 created 2024-04-15T03:20:14Z by 0xb61caff7e185eb0815a6c738a999ab47a2fe7c52, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x306174b707ebf6d7301a0bcd898ae1666ec176ae; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident.

Partial review; no promotion. Source-1 eth_getTransactionReceipt: 3457 logs. Every sell shows MARS Transfer pair 0x27a792d5 -> 0x0 (e.g. log 1691, 1988.5 MARS), then pair Sync with the reduced MARS reserve (log 1692), then the seller's 970-MARS transfer and Swap (logs 1694-1697). callTracer shows 195 CALLs from MARS to pair.sync() (0xfff6cae9) and no DELEGATECALL from MARS. Receipt nets: pair -21.207690225708611838 WBNB and -386366.382782464898512296 MARS (385769.000000000000140527 burned to 0x0, 597.382782464898371769 to fee wallet 0x112ef51e). Attack contract 0xe9067cdd +5.102567430424904448 WBNB; fee-swap recipients 0x0696e4d0 +10.513881044887246882 and 0x810b681e +5.416241750396460508 WBNB; PancakeV3 fee 0.175 WBNB. Runtime: keccak256(eth_getCode) empty at block 37870343 and 0x581a13ad... at 37870344 and 37903299; source-6 receipt gives a top-level creation (index 96) that also creates the pair (PairCreated log 0x179). Campaign scope (unresolved): Etherscan getLogs for MARS Transfer pair -> 0x0 over blocks 37870344-37960000 gives 8147 burn logs in 7223 transactions, the first at block 37901367. Transactions with at least 2 burns include 0x72a68a595b4d72f1bce5d80c79699d9bb3ca4c43fb2771c87eb5ca00dd5f1a00 (block 37902011; bot 0x31781b4e via 0x81da6bcd; pair -0.024094211712371152 WBNB) and 0x6c5b569211ede09a8237706c2edbe9ef9849c95d49131c8b434502fb42dccfb0 (block 37902549; pair -1.242421982275551418 WBNB). These are candidate earlier exercises needing profit and round-trip review. Also source-1 (195 burns); copycat 0xf6775583a3a9d6c71f1fdedfd725e5d3b7e300277b5e2a158562149b8716cc16 (block 37903301, sender 0x27055ae4, 195 burns, pair -33.234581594628596210 WBNB); the attacker's second transaction 0x2e4c71da3766dae55f8e3ba4df1a53146bb474b39a6bf056a0a64f29468e9546 (block 37903352, 159 burns, pair -82.711263643282071803 WBNB); and more than 30 further multi-burn transactions through block 37903612. Next: decide the anchor among the block-37902011/37902549 transactions; sum gross pair WBNB depletion over all multi-burn round trips net of each actor's inputs; and identify the age-bearing gate/burn configuration (see target limitation).

limitations: Earliest successful exercise unresolved: multi-burn transactions at blocks 37902011 and 37902549 precede source-1 (source-5).
Loss unresolved: the imported USD figure lacks provenance, and the full campaign's gross pair depletion has not been summed.
